integrity: Proof states explicit hypotheses and Gaussian limits. verify.py supplies independent exact-rational finite-state corroboration, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Only uniform single-edge toggles on connected simple unicyclic graphs. Even-cycle mixing is measured against the current periodic class, not full stationary distribution. Novelty remains subject to independent historical-priority review, especially coding-theoretic quotient walks.
title: Parity-dependent Gaussian–cosh cutoff profiles for unicyclic edge-toggle walks
